title: 艾瑞莉娅·赤蓝长阶
description: 艾瑞莉娅穿完整红蓝衣甲站在宽石阶，几柄标志刀锋安全静置于身后支架，黑长发与银饰受强光勾边。

art_direction.medium: angular wax-crayon strokes, directional hatching and dramatic hard-edged light on textured paper
art_direction.identity: Irelia is an adult Ionian woman with long dark hair, a precise silver forehead ornament, poised facial features, and elegant blue-red clothing with silver armor accents. Preserve her natural athletic dancer's proportions through a fully covering long-sleeved tunic, opaque trousers, gloves, and boots. Her distinctive curved blades are arranged motionless in a secure stand behind her, not circling a target.
art_direction.scene: Show her pausing in a measured full-body stance on a broad garden stair, weight balanced and hands lowered naturally rather than controlling blades. One distant pavilion roof and enormous pale mountains give depth. Hard diagonal sun cuts through coarse wax-crayon cloth planes and silver edges, while the stored blades remain clearly separate from hair and body in the original quiet composition.
art_direction.palette: deep blue, vermilion, silver gray, pale gold light
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
